title: While Apply places the words on a site whose host still records its starting point, the build console says "Placing your text and pictures on the site" instead of the host's last step
steps: S1: Poll the build job while the host answers running at its baseline step and the brief is placing the words; then while it is not placing.
S2: briefs.placing on a site whose words are being placed, on a site with no brief, and once the work settled.
expect: S1: running with step "placing your text and pictures on the site"; then the host's own step "baseline"; nothing handed over before the host is done.
S2: the placing step; null; null.
evidence: Stand acceptance 16/10/2026 (branch images, Dutch Joomla deschaar1610b): the brief placed its words from ~395 s to ~600 s (applyMs 120 s) while the console showed "Recording a starting point": the poll named the brief's step only once the host job was done
fence: Only while the words are placed (state applying); the host's step otherwise

tests: job poll: words placed while the host still records its starting point are named instead of the host step
a poll after the handover only says "working", and is silent for a site that was never handed over
